== Summary ==
[[Tamás Papp]] (left), [[Scott Lingrell]], [[Kevin Jaap]] and a player in a "New Allies" shirt.

* '''Event:''' [[2024 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2024-09-21
* '''Camera date:''' 2024-09-21 (Day 1; posted that evening)
* '''Identification:''' [[Tamás Papp]]: face match with his [[:File:Tamas Papp (community card).jpg|community card]], and he was the tournament director, here working the organizers' desk in the same blue T-shirt all day; [[Scott Lingrell]]: his face matches his [[:File:Scott Lingrell 2015 Hall of Fame.jpg|2015 Hall of Fame photo]]; [[Kevin Jaap]]: face match with his [[:File:Kevin Jaap 2024 Hall of Fame.jpg|Hall of Fame photo]], where he wears the same white polo. The man at right is not named.
